_comment: ClarityAccount — Custom Object Definition for Module 7 (CRM Integration)
INTENDED DESIGN (storageType: proxy)
The original plan was to create a Proxy Object that would forward all CRUD
operations to an external CRM endpoint:
proxyEndpointURL: /o/headless-admin-user/v1.0/accounts
This would let Liferay's Object Framework expose the CRM data through a
generated REST API at /o/c/clarityaccounts/ without storing anything locally.
PLATFORM LIMITATION
storageType: 'proxy' is NOT supported in Liferay DXP 2026.Q1.2-LTS.
Valid storageType values: 'default', 'salesforce', 'sugarcrm'.
Passing 'proxy' raises: ObjectDefinitionStorageTypeException.
IMPLEMENTED ALTERNATIVE
The object was created with storageType: 'default' (local database storage).
The Object Framework auto-generates the same REST API surface:
GET/POST /o/c/clarityaccounts/
GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /o/c/clarityaccounts/{id}
Students import CRM data via the Headless Batch Engine instead of live proxy.
Pedagogical outcome is identical: a custom object with a REST API, queryable
from fragments and client extensions via fetch().
BATCH IMPORT ALTERNATIVE (for live CRM data)
Use the Headless Batch Engine to load CRM account records:
POST /o/headless-batch-engine/v1.0/import-task/com.liferay.object.rest.dto.v1_0.ObjectEntry
See clarity-crm-sample-accounts.json for the sample payload.
